AccessCertainty.description:
How the reported rights may differ from the truth, given what ADG has not seen.

Not a confidence score. Each value is a *direction*, derived from the conditions that
fired, and it is what lets a consumer tell a finding from a gap: rights reported
``AT_LEAST`` may be wider in reality, which means a risk rule reading them may be
looking at an under-count and must not conclude "nobody has access here".
AccessCertainty.title: AccessCertainty

AccessOutcome.description:
What the answer *is*, as one value a client can branch on.

The values are stable and appear in API responses; renaming one is a contract change.
AccessOutcome.title: AccessOutcome

AppliedAceView.description: One ACE that matched the token, and what it contributed where it sits.

access_mask.description: The entry's own mask, generic bits expanded.
access_mask.title: Access Mask

contributed.description: The part of the mask that survived what earlier entries had already settled. 0x00000000 means the entry is on the ACL and does nothing.
contributed.title: Contributed

layer.description: Which ACL this entry sits on: smb_share or ntfs. Carried on the entry itself so that a list drawn from both layers stays unambiguous — SMB 'Change' and NTFS 'Modify' are the same bits under two names.
layer.title: Layer

matched_key.description: The token entry this ACE named.
matched_key.title: Matched Key

position.description: Index in the DACL as stored. Order is load-bearing.
position.title: Position

AppliedAceView.title: AppliedAceView

BasisView.description:
The collected state an answer was computed from, as the contract renders it.

Every derived response carries one. It is what lets a client say *"as of the run that
finished at 02:14"* instead of *"as of now"*, and what lets two answers fetched minutes
apart be compared honestly: same token, same facts, and any difference between them is a
difference in the question rather than in the estate.

is_empty.description: True when no run has ever been recorded. Every derived answer over an empty estate reports no access, and here that means nobody looked.
is_empty.title: Is Empty

latest_activity_at.description: When a collector last wrote anything.
latest_activity_at.title: Latest Activity At

latest_run_id.description: The most recently updated run. Informational, not the key.
latest_run_id.title: Latest Run Id

token.description: The cache identity of the collected state. Equal tokens mean identical stored facts; this is the value the ETag is built from.
token.title: Token

BasisView.title: BasisView

MembershipImpactView.description:
How many principals a change to this group would affect.

Bounded, and honest about it. ``complete: false`` means the downward traversal hit a
limit, so the counts are lower bounds and the real blast radius is larger — never
smaller.

complete.description: False means the traversal was truncated and both counts are lower bounds.
complete.title: Complete

cycles.description: Membership cycles found below this group. A cycle is a finding.
cycles.title: Cycles

effective_members.description: Principals reachable downward through nesting, the group itself excluded.
effective_members.title: Effective Members

non_group_members.description: Of those, the ones that are not themselves groups: the accounts that would actually hold the rights listed here. Unclassified principals are counted, because an orphaned SID inside a group is a finding and not a rounding error.
non_group_members.title: Non Group Members

MembershipImpactView.title: MembershipImpactView

PageInfo.description: Where a caller is in a list, and how to continue.

has_more.description: Whether more items exist beyond this page.
has_more.title: Has More

limit.description: Maximum items this page could contain.
limit.title: Limit

next_cursor.description: Pass back as ?cursor= to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

total.description: Exact number of items across all pages, when the endpoint can count them cheaply. Null means not counted, never zero.
total.title: Total

PageInfo.title: PageInfo

PrincipalSummary.description: What is known about one principal, as far as any of it is known.

is_group.description: Null when the kind is unknown, never a guessed false.
is_group.title: Is Group

key.description: Storage key: the SID, or host|SID for a local group.
key.title: Key

kind.description: Null when no run has described this principal. The membership that reached it was still observed; only the description is missing.
kind.title: Kind

resolved.description: Whether ADG holds a principal record for this key.
resolved.title: Resolved

PrincipalSummary.title: PrincipalSummary

ResourceImpactView.description: One resource this group's membership reaches, and what it confers there.

explain.description: URL of the full derivation for this pair. Not inlined: an explanation costs a bounded resolution each, and a page of them is not a page a server should compute speculatively.
explain.title: Explain

granted_by.description: Entries that gave rights, both layers, in evaluation order.
granted_by.title: Granted By

limiting_layer.description: Which ACL removed rights the other granted.
limiting_layer.title: Limiting Layer

names_group.description: Whether any entry above names this group itself. False means the rights arrive some other way — through a group this one is nested inside, or through a world SID such as Everyone — and there is no entry naming this group to edit, so 'remove the group from the ACL' is not an available fix on this resource.
names_group.title: Names Group

rights.description: The effective mask a member inherits.

verdict.description: What a member of this group gets here — and, when the answer is no rights, whether that is a Deny, an absence of any grant, or a gap in collection.

ResourceImpactView.title: ResourceImpactView

ResourceRef.description: Enough of a directory to identify it, with whether it was ever read.
ResourceRef.title: ResourceRef

RightsView.description: A rights mask, with its rendering alongside it. The mask is the answer.

categories.description: Every category the mask contains, strongest first.
categories.title: Categories

escalation_rights.description: WRITE_DAC / WRITE_OWNER, when present. The holder can self-grant.
escalation_rights.title: Escalation Rights

extra_rights.description: Rights present beyond what the categories cover.
extra_rights.title: Extra Rights

indeterminate.description: MAXIMUM_ALLOWED is present; Windows resolves it per open, so no fixed rights set exists.
indeterminate.title: Indeterminate

is_exact.description: False when the mask carries rights the label does not name.
is_exact.title: Is Exact

label.description: Display text derived from the mask. Never store or compare it: SMB 'Read' and NTFS 'Read & Execute' are the same bits, and 'Modify' can hide WRITE_DAC.
label.title: Label

layer.description: smb_share, ntfs, or effective. Masks never cross layers.
layer.title: Layer

mask.description: The access mask, as 0xNNNNNNNN. This is authoritative.
mask.title: Mask

primary.description: The strongest category the mask fully contains.
primary.title: Primary

unrecognized_bits.description: Mask bits matching no right ADG knows, as 0xNNNNNNNN.
unrecognized_bits.title: Unrecognized Bits

value.description: The same mask as an integer, for arithmetic.
value.title: Value

RightsView.title: RightsView

ShareRef.description: Enough of a share to identify it, with whether it was ever described.
ShareRef.title: ShareRef

TokenEntryView.description: One SID in the constructed access token, and why it is there.

depth.description: Membership hops from the subject. 0 for the subject itself.
depth.title: Depth

origin.description: subject, group_membership, well_known, or logon_type. The last two are assumptions, not observations.
origin.title: Origin

TokenEntryView.title: TokenEntryView

TokenView.description: The SIDs the ACLs were evaluated against.

membership_complete.description: False means the traversal hit a limit and the token is a lower bound.
membership_complete.title: Membership Complete

TokenView.title: TokenView

VerdictView.description:
The answer as one value, with the evidence that distinguishes it from its neighbors.

``access: false`` is two completely different findings and this is where they are told
apart. Branch on ``outcome``; render ``reason``; and never draw a negative conclusion
while ``conclusive`` is false.

certainty.description: Orthogonal to the outcome: the outcome is the verdict on the evidence, this is the direction the evidence can be wrong in. Both must be rendered.

conclusive.description: False only for 'indeterminate'. While false, 'this principal has no access' is not a statement this response supports.
conclusive.title: Conclusive

denials.description: Deny entries that actually withheld rights, both layers, in evaluation order. A projection of the per-layer 'denied_by' lists, placed here because it is the evidence for a 'denied' outcome. Entries that matched and took nothing away are not here; they are in the layer's 'superseded' list.
denials.title: Denials

may_understate.description: True when the real rights could be wider than reported — keep looking.
may_understate.title: May Understate

outcome.description: granted — rights survive. denied — none survive and a Deny entry is why. no_grant — none survive and nothing denied any; nothing names this principal. indeterminate — none were established and collection is incomplete in a direction that could hide a grant, so this is not a finding of no access.

reason.description: The operator-facing sentence for the outcome.
reason.title: Reason

VerdictView.title: VerdictView

description: Every resource one group's membership reaches, what it confers on each, and how many principals a change would affect. Returned by GET /api/v1/groups/{identifier}/resource-impact.

token.description: The SIDs a member of this group presents: the group, everything it is nested inside, and the SIDs Windows adds to every token of this kind. This is what makes a row appear even when the ACL names a parent group rather than this one.

title: ResourceImpactResponse
